caseName: Duluth, South Shore & Atlantic Railroad v. Michigan Corp.
caseNameFull: DULUTH, SOUTH SHORE & ATLANTIC RAILROAD CO. v. MICHIGAN CORPORATION AND SECURITIES-COMMISSION
attorneys: Henry I. Armstrong, Jr. and Louis F. Dahling. for appellant., Paul L. Adams, Attorney General of Michigan, Samuel. J. Torina, Solicitor General, and William D. Dexter, Assistant Attorney General, for appellees.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

The motion to dismiss is granted and the appeal is dismissed. Treating the papers whereon the appeal was taken as a petition for certiorari, certiorari is denied.
